terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The terms that govern your use of the SentinelX platform.
terms.summary: The short version: you must be 13 or older, one account per person, and you play fair — real results, backed by proof. Prize money pays to your bank through Paystack after an ID check. SX Coins are platform points with no cash value. Nigerian law applies. This summary is not the legal text — the sections below are.
terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern using the SentinelX Esports platform.
terms.s1P1: SentinelX Esports is a mobile esports platform operated by Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke (“we”, “us”, “our”). We are based in Nigeria and our platform is available at sentinelxesports.com.
terms.s1P2: By creating an account or using any part of SentinelX, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2P1: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. If you are under 18, you confirm that you have permission from a parent or guardian to use the platform. Players under 18 may not withdraw prize money without verifiable parental or guardian consent.
terms.s2P2: You may only hold one account. Creating multiple accounts to gain an unfair advantage is prohibited and will result in a permanent ban.
terms.s3P1: You are responsible for keeping your login details secure. Do not share your password with anyone. You are responsible for all activity that takes place under your account.
terms.s3P2: If you believe your account has been compromised, contact us immediately at <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
terms.s4P1: Tournament entry fees are set per event and displayed clearly before registration. The current standard fee is ₦500. By registering and completing payment, you confirm your intent to participate.
terms.s4P2: Entry fees are processed securely by Paystack. We do not store your card details.
terms.s4P3: SX Coins may be used to reduce or eliminate entry fees where that option is offered. See the <link>Refund Policy</link> for how cancellations are handled.
terms.s5Intro: All players must compete honestly. The following are prohibited:
terms.s5List:
• Submitting false or manipulated match results
  • Using external tools, scripts, or exploits to gain an advantage
  • Colluding with an opponent to produce a predetermined result
  • Threatening, harassing, or abusing opponents
terms.s5P2: Match results must be submitted with supporting evidence (screenshot and screen recording). Admin decisions on disputed results are final. Full conduct and match rules are in the <link>Tournament Rules</link>.
terms.s5P3: A no-show — failing to appear for your scheduled match without notice — results in a forfeit and a penalty to your SX Score.
terms.s6P1: Prize money is paid to the bank account you link to your player dashboard via Paystack. You must complete identity verification before your first withdrawal.
terms.s6P2: We aim to process approved withdrawals within 1–5 business days. We are not responsible for delays caused by your bank.
terms.s7P1: SX Coins are a virtual in-platform currency. They are earned by competing and spending time on the platform. SX Coins have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash. They may be used within the platform for entry fee discounts, community features, and the in-platform store. SX Coins may also be staked in community wagering (see section 8), and can be lost if your wager does not win.
terms.s8P1: You may stake SX Coins on the outcome of a match you are not playing in. Wagering is optional and uses SX Coins only.
terms.s8List:
• Wagering opens once both players are confirmed for a scheduled match and closes 15 minutes before the scheduled start time. For matches scheduled across a full day, it closes 24 hours after that day begins.
  • A 5% platform fee is taken from the losing pool. Winnings are paid in SX Coins only.
  • Wagers settle automatically from the admin-confirmed match result, and that settlement is final.
  • If a match is voided or a result is overturned, every stake is returned in full.
terms.s8P2: Because SX Coins have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash, community wagering is not betting for money.
terms.s9P1: The Gaming Exchange (powered by Zolarux escrow) allows players to buy and sell gaming accounts and in-game items. SentinelX provides the platform and escrow infrastructure. We are not party to the transaction between buyer and seller and are not liable for disputes that arise from transactions conducted outside the platform's escrow system. See <link>how escrow works</link> for the step-by-step.
terms.s10P1: You agree to treat all other members of the SentinelX community with respect. Hate speech, discrimination, threats, and harassment are not tolerated and will result in suspension or permanent ban. See our <link>Community Rules</link> for the full standards.
terms.s11P1: All SentinelX branding, design, and original content is owned by SentinelX Esports. You may not reproduce, copy, or distribute our content without written permission. Content you post (match screenshots, community posts) remains yours, but you grant us a licence to display it on the platform.
terms.s12P1: SentinelX Esports is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability to you for any claim shall not exceed the total entry fees you have paid to us in the 3 months prior to the claim.
terms.s12P2: We do not guarantee uninterrupted access to the platform. We will make reasonable efforts to restore service promptly in the event of downtime.
terms.s13P1: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will notify you via the platform or email when significant changes are made. Continuing to use SentinelX after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s14P1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Nigerian courts.
terms.s15P1: Questions about these Terms? Email us at <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> or message us on WhatsApp: <whatsapp>+234 903 239 5685</whatsapp>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.summary: The short version: we collect what we need to run your account, tournaments, and payouts — we don’t sell anything to advertisers. Your username, profile and match record are public. You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data at any time. The full detail is below.
privacy.metaDescription: How SentinelX Esports collects, uses, and protects your personal data under Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023.
privacy.s1P1: SentinelX Esports, operated by Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke, is the data controller for personal information collected through this platform. Contact: <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
privacy.s2AccountList:
• Email address
  • Username and display name
  • Country
  • Password (stored as a secure hash — we never see your plain password)
privacy.s2ProfileList:
• WhatsApp phone number (optional — used only for match notifications if you opt in)
  • Profile photo
  • Bio
privacy.s2Tournament: When you register for a tournament:
privacy.s2TournamentList:
• Payment information (processed by Paystack — we receive a transaction reference, not your card details)
  • Bank account details (collected by Paystack for prize withdrawals — stored by Paystack, not by us)
privacy.s2PlayList:
• Match history, scores, and results
  • SX Score and rankings
  • Achievements and SX Coins balance
  • Match screenshots and recordings you submit for result verification
  • Community wagering — the matches you staked on, your picks, stake amounts, and outcomes
  • SX Coins transaction history (earns, spends, wagers, refunds)
privacy.s2AutoList:
• Log data (IP address, browser type, pages visited) — used for security and to fix bugs
  • Session cookies (required for login to work)

account.purpose: Running your account and the platform

whatsapp.basis: Consent — you opt in by adding your phone number

privacy.s4Heading: 4. Who We Share Your Data With
privacy.s4Intro: We share data only where necessary:
privacy.s4List:
• Paystack — payment processing and bank account verification for prize payouts
  • Supabase — database and authentication infrastructure (servers may be located outside Nigeria; Supabase Inc. operates under appropriate data transfer safeguards)
  • Vercel — web hosting
  • Termii (when active) — WhatsApp notification delivery, only for players who have added a phone number
  • Firebase / Google — push notification delivery (FCM)
privacy.s4P2: We do not sell your personal data. We do not share it with advertisers.
privacy.s4P3: We may disclose data to Nigerian law enforcement or regulatory bodies if legally required to do so.
privacy.s5P1: Your username, display name, country, profile photo, SX Score, match history, and achievements are visible to all visitors of the platform. This is necessary for the competitive, community nature of the platform. You can update your display name and photo at any time in Settings.
privacy.s6Intro: As a data subject, you have the right to:
privacy.s6List:
• Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
  • Rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate data
  • Erasure — ask us to delete your account and personal data
  • Restriction — ask us to limit how we process your data
  • Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interest
  • Withdraw consent — remove your WhatsApp number or turn off notifications at any time in Settings
privacy.s6P2: To exercise any of these rights, email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s6P3: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) at <link>ndpc.gov.ng</link>.
privacy.s7P1: We keep your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will erase your personal data within 30 days, except where we are required by law to retain it (for example, payment records may be retained for up to 7 years for tax and financial compliance).
privacy.s7P2: Match records and results may be retained in anonymised form for platform statistics.
privacy.s8P1: We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, and role-based access controls. No system is perfectly secure — if you believe your account has been compromised, contact us immediately.
privacy.s9P1: Players under 18 may use the platform with parental consent. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has created an account, we will delete it.
privacy.s10P1: We will notify you via the platform or email if we make significant changes to this policy. The latest version is always available at sentinelxesports.com/privacy.

refundPolicy.summary: The short version: entry fees come back if a tournament is cancelled or cannot run — not if you are disqualified or simply change your mind. A payment that debited you but failed to register is always refunded.
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026
refundPolicy.metaDescription: When tournament entry fees, coin discounts, and prize money are and are not refundable.
refundPolicy.s1P1: Entry fees are generally non-refundable once your registration is confirmed and the tournament has started.
refundPolicy.s1RefundIntro: You are entitled to a full refund if:
refundPolicy.s1RefundList:
• The tournament is cancelled by SentinelX before it begins
  • Your registration is rejected by admin before the bracket is published
  • A technical error on our platform prevents you from participating
refundPolicy.s1NoRefundList:
• You no-show for your scheduled match
  • You are disqualified for a rule violation after the tournament begins
  • You change your mind after the bracket is published
refundPolicy.s1P2: Refunds are processed via the original payment method and typically take 3–7 business days to appear.
refundPolicy.s2Heading: Entry Fee Discounts Using SX Coins
refundPolicy.s2Intro: If you used SX Coins to reduce or waive your entry fee:
refundPolicy.s2List:
• The coin portion is refunded as coins (not naira) in the event of a qualifying cancellation
  • Coins are credited back to your balance immediately upon refund
refundPolicy.s3P1: Prize money is credited to your linked bank account after admin approval. Once approved, payouts cannot be reversed. If you believe a prize was incorrectly calculated, contact us within 7 days of the result being confirmed.
refundPolicy.s4P1: SX Coins are a virtual currency earned through platform activity. They have no cash value and are non-refundable. If your account is closed for a serious rule violation, coins are forfeited.
refundPolicy.s5P1: Email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> with your username, the tournament name, and the reason for your request. We will respond within 3 business days.

rules.summary: The short version: show up on time, play the format the tournament sets, keep a recording, and submit your result with proof. No-shows and cheating cost you SX Score. An admin’s ruling on a dispute is final.
rules.title: Tournament Rules
rules.metaDescription: Eligibility, match, result-submission, dispute, and conduct rules that apply to every SentinelX tournament.
rules.eligibilityList:
• You must have a registered and verified SentinelX account
  • You must pay the entry fee (₦500 or reduced with SX Coins) before the registration deadline
  • Players serving an active suspension are not eligible to enter
rules.beforeList:
• Registration closes before the bracket is generated — you cannot register after the deadline
  • Check your fixture (your scheduled match) on your Player Dashboard after the bracket is published
  • Be online and ready 15 minutes before your scheduled match time
rules.playingList:
• Matches are played on the agreed game and platform (DLS, EA FC Mobile, eFootball, etc.) as specified in the tournament details
  • Both players must join the match lobby at the scheduled time
  • If you cannot find your opponent after waiting 10 minutes from the scheduled start time, take a screenshot of the empty lobby and submit it as a no-show report
rules.submittingList:
• The winner is responsible for submitting the result
  • Submit a screenshot of the final scoreline AND a screen recording of the match
  • Results must be submitted within 2 hours of the match ending
  • Admin reviews and confirms the result — the bracket updates only after confirmation
rules.noShowList:
• Failing to appear for your scheduled match is a no-show
  • No-show: your opponent advances automatically, and you lose 100 SX Score points
  • Repeated no-shows may result in suspension from future tournaments
rules.disputesList:
• If the submitted result is incorrect, the losing player may raise a dispute within 1 hour of submission
  • Admin will review both players' screen recordings and make a final decision
  • Admin decisions on disputes are final
  • Raising a false dispute (deliberately contesting a correct result) results in an SX Score penalty
rules.conductList:
• Treat your opponent with respect — harassment, hate speech, or threats will result in immediate disqualification and suspension
  • Match fixing or collusion is a permanent ban offence
  • Using game exploits or external tools is a permanent ban offence
rules.prizesList:
• Prizes are credited to the winner's wallet after admin confirms the final result
  • Players must complete KYC verification before withdrawing prize money
  • Withdrawal requests are processed within 1–5 business days

communityRules.summary: The short version: treat people with respect. No harassment, spam, doxxing, cheating talk, or NSFW content. Breaking these gets you muted, suspended, or banned.
communityRules.title: Community Rules
communityRules.metaDescription: The standards that keep SentinelX's community positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.intro: SentinelX is Nigeria's home of mobile esports. The community is for everyone who loves the game — we keep it positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.basicP1: Treat every member the way you'd want to be treated at a tournament in person. Behind every username is a real person.
communityRules.harassmentP1: No insults, threats, or discrimination based on tribe, religion, gender, region, or any other personal characteristic. This includes DMs.
communityRules.spamP1: No repeated posting of the same content, no promotional links without permission, no bot activity.
communityRules.falseInfoP1: Do not post fake match results, fake screenshots, or misleading claims about other players.
communityRules.privacyP1: Do not share another player's personal information (phone number, address, real name if they use a username) without their consent.
communityRules.cheatingP1: Do not share or promote methods for cheating in any game supported on the platform.
communityRules.nsfwP1: No explicit, violent, or disturbing content of any kind.
communityRules.consequencesP1:
First offence: Warning
Second offence: Temporary suspension (7–30 days depending on severity)
Serious offences (hate speech, threats, doxxing, cheating): Immediate suspension or permanent ban, no warning required
communityRules.reportingP1: See something that breaks these rules? Use the report button on any post, or email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. Reports are reviewed by the admin team. We take every report seriously.

safety.summary: The short version: protect your login and never share your password — we will never ask for it. Trade only through the platform’s escrow, and report anything that feels off.
safety.title: Stay Safe on SentinelX
safety.metaDescription: How to protect your account, your prize money, and yourself while trading or playing on SentinelX.
safety.protectAccountList:
• Use a strong, unique password for SentinelX — don't reuse it from another app
  • Never share your password with anyone, including people claiming to be SentinelX staff
  • Log out of shared devices after playing
  • If your email gets a reset request you didn't make, change your password immediately and contact us
safety.neverAskHeading: We Will Never Ask For This
safety.neverAskIntro: SentinelX staff will never ask for your:
safety.neverAskList:
• Password
  • Bank account PIN or BVN
  • Paystack OTP codes
  • Payment to “unlock” prize money
safety.neverAskP2: If anyone claiming to be SentinelX asks for any of these, it is a scam. Report it to us immediately.
safety.protectPrizeList:
• Only link your own bank account for withdrawals
  • Verify your account before your first withdrawal — this protects you
  • Prize withdrawals only go through the platform dashboard. Anyone asking you to send money first to “unlock” winnings is a scammer
safety.safeTradingList:
• Always use the Zolarux Escrow system for all trades. Funds held in escrow are protected until both parties confirm the transaction
  • Never agree to complete a trade outside the platform — if a buyer or seller asks to go outside escrow, refuse and report them
  • If a deal looks too good to be true, it probably is
safety.matchSafetyList:
• Record your screen for every match — this is your protection if a result is disputed
  • Save your recordings until after the result is officially confirmed on the platform
  • If your opponent is being abusive or threatening, take screenshots and report via the platform or email us

escrow.title: Safe Trading with Zolarux Escrow
escrow.metaDescription: How Zolarux Escrow protects buyers and sellers on the SentinelX Gaming Exchange.
escrow.summary: The short version: the Gaming Exchange will hold the buyer’s payment safely until both sides confirm the deal is done. Trade outside the escrow and you carry the risk yourself.
escrow.whatIsExchangeP1: The Gaming Exchange will be SentinelX’s marketplace for gaming accounts, in-game items, and digital gaming assets — built for Nigerian mobile gamers who want to buy and sell safely, without the risk of being scammed. It is not live yet; this page explains how it will work when it launches.
escrow.whatIsExchangeP2: Every transaction on the Exchange will be protected by Zolarux Escrow. <link>Browse the Exchange →</link>
escrow.whatIsEscrowP1: Zolarux is an independent escrow service. Escrow means a trusted third party holds a payment until both sides of a transaction are satisfied. Neither the buyer's money nor the seller's item is transferred until the deal is confirmed as complete.
escrow.buyerList:
• You find an item you want and agree on a price
  • You send payment to Zolarux (not directly to the seller)
  • The seller delivers the item or account
  • You confirm you've received it and it's as described
  • Zolarux releases the payment to the seller
escrow.buyerP2: If the item is not delivered or is misrepresented, you can raise a dispute and your money is returned.
escrow.sellerList:
• You list your item on the Exchange
  • A buyer purchases it — their payment goes to Zolarux, not to you yet
  • You deliver the item or transfer the account
  • The buyer confirms receipt
  • Zolarux releases your payment
escrow.sellerP2: You only deliver once the buyer's payment is confirmed as held in escrow.
escrow.whyNotDirectP1: Trading outside of escrow — whether via WhatsApp, direct transfer, or any other method — is not protected. SentinelX cannot help you recover money or items lost in trades that took place outside the platform's escrow system.
escrow.whyNotDirectP2: If a buyer or seller asks you to complete a trade outside the escrow system, decline and report them.

tournamentGuide.summary: The short version: check the game, format, and schedule before you register, keep your screen recording running through your match, and submit your result promptly with a screenshot.
tournamentGuide.title: Tournament Guide
tournamentGuide.subtitle: Everything you need to know.
tournamentGuide.metaDescription: Everything you need to know before, during, and after a SentinelX tournament match.
tournamentGuide.checkGameP: Each tournament specifies which game is being played. Make sure you have it installed and your in-game account is ready.
tournamentGuide.checkFormatP: Tournaments use group stages (for large fields) followed by single-elimination knockout rounds. The tournament page shows how many groups, how many advance, and the prize structure.
tournamentGuide.checkScheduleP: Tournaments have a registration deadline and a start date. Once registration closes, the bracket is generated and no late entries are accepted.
tournamentGuide.checkBalanceP: Entry fee is ₦500. If you don't have enough SX Coins for a discount, make sure your card is ready for the Paystack payment.
tournamentGuide.registeringList:
• Go to Tournaments → find an open tournament → click Register
  • Choose your coin discount option (if available)
  • Complete payment via Paystack (or confirm free entry if using full coin discount)
  • You'll receive a WhatsApp confirmation if you have a number saved in Settings
tournamentGuide.afterRegP1: Your fixture appears in Dashboard → My Matches once the bracket is published. This shows you who you're playing, what time, and which round.
tournamentGuide.afterRegP2: Set a reminder. SentinelX will send a WhatsApp reminder 1 hour before your match if notifications are enabled.
tournamentGuide.prepareP: Unstable internet is your responsibility — connection issues during a match are not grounds for a result reversal.
tournamentGuide.recordLabel: Start recording before the match begins.
tournamentGuide.recordP: Go to your phone's screen recorder and start it before you enter the game lobby. This recording is your evidence if the result is ever disputed.
tournamentGuide.joinP: If you can't find your opponent 10 minutes after the scheduled start, screenshot the empty lobby and report it as a no-show.
tournamentGuide.playP: No exploits, no rage quits, no abuse.
tournamentGuide.submittingIntro: The winner submits the result — not the loser.
tournamentGuide.submittingList:
• Go to Dashboard → My Matches → the match → Submit Result
  • Upload your screenshot (final scoreline clearly visible)
  • Upload your screen recording
  • Click Submit
tournamentGuide.submittingP2: You have 2 hours from the end of the match to submit. After that, a no-submission may be treated as a no-show.
tournamentGuide.afterSubmissionP1: Admin reviews your submission. If the result looks clean, it's confirmed within 24 hours and the bracket updates. The loser has 1 hour after submission to raise a dispute if they believe the result is wrong.
tournamentGuide.afterSubmissionP2: If you win a prize, it appears in your wallet after the final result is confirmed.
tournamentGuide.tipsList:
• Save all your recordings until after the official confirmation — you may need them for a dispute
  • If you lose, don't quit the app mid-match — abandoning counts against your SX Score
  • Good sportsmanship in the community is noticed. Your reputation matters beyond just your score

tournamentFaqs.title: Tournament FAQs
tournamentFaqs.metaDescription: Answers to the most common questions about entering, playing, and getting paid from SentinelX tournaments.
tournamentFaqs.q1: Can I enter more than one tournament at a time?
tournamentFaqs.a1: Yes. You can be registered in multiple active tournaments simultaneously.
tournamentFaqs.a2: DLS (Dream League Soccer) is the current primary game. EA FC Mobile, eFootball, PUBG Mobile, Free Fire, Call of Duty Mobile, and Mortal Kombat are coming in a future update.
tournamentFaqs.q3: How are groups and brackets decided?
tournamentFaqs.a3: When registration closes, the system automatically generates groups based on how many players registered. Admin can review and adjust before publishing. The bracket is then single-elimination from the group stage onwards.
tournamentFaqs.q4: What if I need to withdraw from a tournament after registering?
tournamentFaqs.a4: Withdrawal after registration closes is not eligible for a refund unless the tournament is cancelled by SentinelX. If you know in advance you can't play, contact us as early as possible.
tournamentFaqs.q5: Can I play from any device?
tournamentFaqs.a5: Yes, as long as the required game is installed and you can maintain a stable connection. All supported games are mobile titles — PC or console play is not applicable.
tournamentFaqs.a6: Failing to appear in the game lobby within 10 minutes of the scheduled match start time. If you're running late, message your opponent via the platform immediately.
tournamentFaqs.q7: Can I play a match early if both players agree?
tournamentFaqs.a7: No. Matches must be played at the scheduled time to maintain bracket integrity. Contact admin if you both need to reschedule — admin may approve it at their discretion.
tournamentFaqs.q8: What if I lose internet during a match?
tournamentFaqs.a8: Connection loss during a match is not grounds for a result reversal or replay. If you disconnect during a match and your opponent can demonstrate completion, the result stands.
tournamentFaqs.q9: How long are tournament prizes held before expiry?
tournamentFaqs.a9: Prize money does not expire — it stays in your wallet until you withdraw it. Ensure your bank account is linked and verified to withdraw.
tournamentFaqs.q10: I won but my result wasn't confirmed — what do I do?
tournamentFaqs.a10: First, check that you submitted within 2 hours with both a screenshot and a recording. If you did and it's been over 24 hours with no update, contact admin at sentinelxesports@gmail.com.

contact.beforeYouWrite: Many answers are already in the <help>Help Centre</help> — or ask the in-app assistant. Still need us? Reach out below.
contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Whether you have a question about a tournament, a problem with your account, or something else — we're reachable and we respond.
contact.metaDescription: Reach the SentinelX team by email or WhatsApp — we aim to respond within 24 hours.
contact.emailResponseNote: We aim to respond within 24 hours on business days.
contact.whatsappNote: Message us directly — fastest for urgent issues like match disputes or account problems.
contact.whatToIncludeHeading: What to Include in Your Message
contact.whatToIncludeIntro: To help us resolve your issue quickly, include:
contact.whatToIncludeList:
• Your SentinelX username
  • The tournament name (if relevant)
  • A clear description of the problem
  • Any screenshots that help explain the issue
contact.forgotPasswordP: Use the “Forgot Password” link on the login page — no need to contact us.
contact.matchDisputeP: Include the match ID and your screen recording.
contact.withdrawalP: Allow 1–5 business days before contacting us. Include your withdrawal request date and bank name.
contact.reportAbuseP1: If you're experiencing harassment, threats, or have a safety concern, email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> with “URGENT” in the subject line. We prioritise these reports.

help.title: Help Center
help.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about accounts, tournaments, prizes, SX Score, and SX Coins.

gettingStarted.heading: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: How do I create an account?
gettingStarted.a1: Click "Sign Up" on the homepage. Enter your email address and choose a username. Verify your email using the link we send you, then complete your profile.
gettingStarted.a2: Yes, but only once. Go to Settings to make the change. After that, your username is locked — contact support if you have a serious reason to change it again.
gettingStarted.a3: Creating an account and browsing the platform is free. Entering tournaments costs ₦500 per tournament, or you can use SX Coins you've earned to reduce or eliminate the fee.

tournaments.heading: Tournaments
tournaments.q1: How do I register for a tournament?
tournaments.a1: Go to the Tournaments page, find an open tournament, and click "Register." You'll be taken to the payment screen. Complete your ₦500 payment via Paystack to confirm your spot.
tournaments.q2: What happens if I miss my match?
tournaments.a2: A no-show means your opponent advances automatically and you lose 100 SX Score points. Always check your fixture on your Player Dashboard and set a reminder.
tournaments.q3: How do I submit a match result?
tournaments.a3: Go to Dashboard → My Matches → Submit Result. Upload a screenshot of the final scoreline and a screen recording of the match. Both are required.
tournaments.q4: What if my opponent submits a wrong result?
tournaments.a4: You can dispute the result within 1 hour of submission. Go to the match page and click "Dispute." Admin will review both players' recordings and make a final decision.
tournaments.q5: How long does it take for results to be confirmed?
tournaments.a5: Admin aims to confirm results within 24 hours of submission. Complex disputes may take longer.
tournaments.q6: What if a tournament is cancelled?
tournaments.a6: You'll receive a full refund to your original payment method within 3–7 business days.

prizes.heading: Prizes and Payments
prizes.q1: How do I withdraw my prize money?
prizes.a1: Go to Dashboard → Wallet → Withdraw. Link your Nigerian bank account (first time only), enter the amount, and submit a withdrawal request. We'll process it within 1–5 business days.
prizes.q2: Is there a minimum withdrawal amount?
prizes.q3: Why do I need to verify my identity before withdrawing?
prizes.a3: We verify your bank account via Paystack to ensure prize money goes to the right person and to comply with Nigerian financial regulations.
prizes.q4: When will I receive my withdrawal?
prizes.a4: Typically 1–5 business days after your request is approved. Delays can occur due to your bank's processing times, which are outside our control.

sxScore.heading: SX Score
sxScore.a1: SX Score is your reliability and fair-play rating on the platform. Every player starts at 700. It goes up when you win and behave well, and down when you no-show, cheat, or lose disputes.
sxScore.q2: What are the SX Score tiers?
sxScore.a2: 900 and above: Elite (🟢). 750–899: Trusted (🔵). 600–749: Developing (🟡). Below 600: At Risk (🔴).
sxScore.a3: Yes. There's no floor cap — you can always earn your way back up by competing fairly.

sxCoins.heading: SX Coins
sxCoins.a1: SX Coins are an in-platform virtual currency. You earn them by competing, completing challenges, and unlocking achievements.
sxCoins.q2: Can I convert SX Coins to naira?
sxCoins.a2: No. SX Coins are virtual and cannot be exchanged for cash. They can only be spent within the platform.
sxCoins.q3: What can I spend SX Coins on?
sxCoins.a3: Tournament entry fee discounts (500 coins = ₦250 off, 1,000 coins = free entry), post boosts in the community, and items in the in-platform store.

accountSafety.heading: Account and Safety
accountSafety.q1: I forgot my password. What do I do?
accountSafety.a1: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. We'll send a reset link to your registered email address.
accountSafety.q2: How do I report a player?
accountSafety.a2: Email sentinelxesports@gmail.com with the player's username and details of the incident. For community posts, use the report button on the post.
accountSafety.q3: I think my account has been hacked. What do I do?
accountSafety.a3: Change your password immediately using the "Forgot Password" link on the login page, then email us at sentinelxesports@gmail.com. We'll lock the account and help you recover it.

howItWorks.title: How SentinelX Works
howItWorks.subtitle: SentinelX is where Nigerian mobile gamers compete in organised tournaments, build their reputation, and win real prize money — all from their phone. Here's how to get started.
howItWorks.metaDescription: From creating an account to getting paid — how Nigerian mobile gamers compete on SentinelX.
howItWorks.step1Body: Sign up with your email and choose a username. Your username is your esports identity on the platform — pick something you're proud of. Your player profile shows your SX Score, win rate, achievements, and match history. Build it up tournament by tournament.
howItWorks.step2Body: Browse the Tournaments page to find open registrations. Each tournament shows the game, entry fee, prize pool, format, and registration deadline. Pay the ₦500 entry fee with your card via Paystack. Or use SX Coins you've earned through competing — 1,000 coins get you a free entry.
howItWorks.step3Body: Once registration closes, admin generates the bracket. You'll see your fixture (who you're playing and when) on your Player Dashboard. You'll also receive a match reminder on WhatsApp if you've added your number in Settings.
howItWorks.step4Body: Play the match at the scheduled time. Keep it clean — no exploits, no rage quits. After the match: the winner takes a screenshot of the final score and records the match on their phone. Both are required for result submission.
howItWorks.step5Body: Go to your Player Dashboard → My Matches → Submit Result. Upload your screenshot and screen recording. Admin reviews the submission and confirms the result. The bracket updates only after admin confirms — never before.
howItWorks.step6Body: Win your bracket and the prize money is credited to your wallet. Link your Nigerian bank account and request a withdrawal — money arrives in 1–5 business days.
howItWorks.sxScoreBody: Every player starts with an SX Score of 700. Win matches, show up on time, and behave well — your score goes up. No-shows and disputes bring it down. Your score determines your trust tier on the platform.
howItWorks.sxCoinsBody: You earn SX Coins by competing, completing weekly challenges, and unlocking achievements. Spend them on entry fee discounts, boosting your community posts, and the in-platform store. Coins are earned — they cannot be bought with cash, and they cannot be converted to naira.
howItWorks.communityBody: Post in the community feed, react to match highlights, and take on weekly challenges. The community is public — anyone can read it, but you need an account to post.
howItWorks.teamLeaguesBody: teams representing a school or state, with team-vs-team standings.
